messages:
ops-bot: :rotating_light: Incident detected — elevated 5xx spike on /v1/generate (us-west). Alert INC-2026-0423-1. Paging current on‑call: maria.

maria: ack — I'm on it, looking at runtime and edge traces.

maria: quick triage notes: errors concentrated on model "redwood-7b-quant"; front proxy reporting 502s; seeing kv cache warnings in runtime logs.

james: joining — no deploys in the last 2 hours on prod, checked CI pipeline.

anya: I'm available for handover in ~10m, will stay for initial mitigation.

devon: customer support: two enterprise tenants opened tickets (#4123, #4124) reporting failed requests and user-visible errors. Need ETA for account teams.

maria: live plan: 1) collect pod and proxy logs 2) build timeline 3) apply routing override to fallback variant 4) draft statuspage + customer note.

maria: runtime log snippet (relevant lines):

```
[2026-04-23T02:17:12Z] ERROR serve: request_id=abc123 model=redwood-7b-quant kv_cache_fail=true err="kv cache OOM"
[2026-04-23T02:17:13Z] WARN  router: backend=pool-7 retry=1 upstream_status=502
[2026-04-23T02:17:14Z] INFO  batching: batch_size=1 latency_ms=1200
```

james: hypothesis A — KV-cache memory pressure causing eviction/requests to fail (propagates as 502). Hypothesis B — quantization/kernel mismatch causing runtime exceptions under certain sequence lengths.

anya: metrics to collect: p99 latency, error rate by model, GPU memory usage, OOM events, request size distribution.

maria: running quick grep for "kv_cache_fail":

```
kubectl logs -l app=runtime -n prod --since=15m | grep kv_cache_fail | tail -n 50
```

lina: statuspage draft (short, neutral):

```
We are currently investigating elevated error rates for text generation in US‑West. Impact: intermittent failed requests (HTTP 502/500) for some models. Mitigation in progress. We'll update within 30 minutes.
```

devon: add guidance for customers: recommend retries with exponential backoff; for enterprise customers we can enable fallback to a smaller non-quantized model if needed.

maria: mitigation step: applying routing override to prefer redwood-7b-fp16 for new requests to reduce exposure to quant variant — executing now.

ops-bot: action logged: route override applied -> pool=dedicated-usw, policy=prefer-fp16, expires=30m.

maria: early telemetry: observed 502 rate drop from ~12% -> ~4% within 6m of route override. Collecting more tail metrics.

james: still seeing GPU memory trending up on node gpu-17 — `nvidia-smi` snapshot below:

```
Timestamp: 2026-04-23T02:25:30Z
GPU17 Mem: 17.9GB / 24GB
Processes: serve(86%), kv_cache(10%) ...
```

anya: adding timeline anchors: 02:17 UTC alert, 02:20 initial triage started, 02:24 routing override applied, 02:30 partial recovery telemetry.

maria: assigning post-incident owners: runtime= maria, kernel/quant= james, customer comms= devon, capacity/validation= anya.

devon: I'll draft and send a short enterprise note to affected accounts in ~15m. Any specifics to include?

maria: include: what we changed (routing override), short impact summary, expected next update window, and contact for escalation.

lina: statuspage v1 posted to internal-comms (link). Proposed public text below for sign-off:

```
Update 02:40 UTC: We implemented a routing override to reduce errors. Some customers may still see intermittent failures; our engineers continue root cause analysis. No data loss is expected. Next update in 60 minutes or sooner.
```

maria: please upload filtered logs for the RCA; prefer an internal log-share link rather than pasting huge blocks.

james: uploaded filtered logs -> https://internal-logs.company/links/abcd1234 (eng access only). Includes kv_cache_fail traces + stack snippets.

anya: hypothesis tracking (please update status next to each):
- KV cache OOM under long-context loads: status=open, evidence=logs showing "kv_cache_fail", next=replicate with stress harness.
- Quant/kernel mismatch under long sequences: status=open, evidence=partial GPU traces, next=verify model build flags and reproduce.

maria: replication note — launching local stress test with long sessions (~8k tokens) to try and reproduce kv pressure; will attach results.

devon: customer impact mapping: affected accounts = AccountA (#4123), AccountB (#4124), small ecom customer. Severity classified as SEV2 (partial customer impact, degraded service).

ops-bot: reminder: handoff scheduled at 03:00 UTC per rotation. If unresolved, oncall shift to anya.

anya: I will take over at 03:00 and continue triage. Leaving a concise outstanding task list please.

maria: outstanding tasks for handoff: 1) finish replication attempt; 2) validate kernel/quant build flags; 3) schedule postmortem and assign owners; 4) update public statuspage in ~60m. Adding timestamps to timeline doc now.

lina: status text approved. If we reach a stable state before 03:30, I'll coordinate a stakeholder email summarizing impact and next steps.

devon: I'll notify account managers with the FAQ and escalation path; will flag any high-priority escalations here.

maria: logging final handoff note — leaving timeline and artifacts in incident doc. Ping loudly if errors resurge. :white_check_mark:

ops-bot: incident summary saved -> https://docs.internal/incident/1939999999 (owner=maria). Pager closed to day-oncall at 03:00 per scheduled handoff.
